_howto: ICC World Test Championship context for the Test card. NO fetchable feed exists: ICC's standings page renders client-side (curl gets a shell), ICC's rankings/content APIs 404 on standings, and ESPN's WTC league (19430) returns standings for only the two teams playing that day with ranks that disagree with ICC. So this is CURATED — refresh it by reading ICC's table and updating 'verified'. The UI always shows the as-of date and links to the live table, so staleness is visible, never disguised.
